messages:
aisha: :rotating_light: Seeing a sustained spike in 5xx from the canary group hitting the experimental prompt endpoint on prompt-router v2.3. Error rate ~8% over the last 10m. Paging @mike_oncall — can we engage the safety toggle and eject canary traffic?

incident-bot: Incident created INC-2026-03-17-042 • severity=P2 • paging mike_oncall • link: https://incidents.internal/INC-2026-03-17-042

mike_oncall: on it. grabbing logs/trace windows now. can you paste a couple of sample request IDs or a quick query? :eyes:

aisha: sample req IDs: rQ1-9a2b3c, rQ1-9a2b7f, rQ1-9a2c00. Root symptoms: GPU kernel errors in runtime logs, followed by 5xx from the experimental handler.

lina_pd: heads-up to CSMs going out — if we flip, customers on the canary cohort will be routed back to stable. ETA expectations?

aisha: plan: flip feature flag that routes requests away from experimental endpoint to stable prompt-router. I can run the toggle or mike can. Flag: prompt_router.experimental_endpoint (ON -> OFF).

deploy-bot: Suggested command:
```
/flag-toggle prompt_router.experimental_endpoint off --who=\"mike_oncall\" --reason=\"canary-5xx-spike\"
```

mike_oncall: executing toggle now. running API call to internal flags service:
```
curl -X POST https://flags.internal/api/v1/toggle \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer REDACTED\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{\"flag\":\"prompt_router.experimental_endpoint\",\"state\":\"off\",\"note\":\"canary 5xx spike\"}'
```

mike_oncall: toggle response 200 OK — flag set to OFF. Confirming rollout and traffic routing policy applied. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Safety net engaged. Traffic policy: experimental -> stable; canary group ejected. Telemetry watchers: expect normalization within 60-120s.

aisha: metrics: error rate dropping — 5xx now 2.1% and trending down, p50/p95 latency returning to baseline. Good signal. :thumbsup:

sara_csm: notifying affected accounts and creating internal tracking ticket (#12345). I'll include timeline and who we notified.

dan: I'll take the on-call watch for the next 30m. ping me if anything flares back up.

mike_oncall: handing off to dan at 10:22 UTC. Summary for handoff: toggled prompt_router.experimental_endpoint -> OFF at 10:05 UTC, observed immediate drop in error rate. Initial logs indicate kernel mismatch on GPU runtime for the new endpoint variant; eng-runtime is running deeper debugging.

lina_pd: updating status page draft: \"Degraded: experimental prompt endpoint — mitigation applied; traffic rerouted to stable. We are investigating cause; no customer-facing data loss. Updates as available.\" Will publish in 10m unless we have a clearer RCA.

aisha: action items captured: (1) eng-runtime: investigate kernel mismatch and model variant compatibility; (2) infra/ops: run a controlled canary test on a non-prod fleet after kernel patch; (3) CSM/support: monitor ticket #12345 and escalate if customer errors persist.

mike_oncall: leaving notes in incident system and will follow up with eng-runtime; if no recurrence, we'll close in 30m. If it reappears, escalate to SEV1 and re-page SRE leads. :mag_right:

incident-bot: Updated INC-2026-03-17-042 timeline: mitigation applied (flag flip) at 10:05 UTC; monitoring window open.

aisha: thanks everyone. keeping this thread open for postmortem links and final close. :pray:
_meta_note: This file represents a single Slack thread. Messages are a continuous string, messages prefixed by sender display name.
